measured.platform: Android 10, Chrome 157, Web Gamepad API (mapping: standard)

device.vendorNote: Spoofed Microsoft Xbox Wireless Controller IDs. Identical for both halves and for combined mode. Never identify the GT NX by VID/PID alone.

match.note: Regexes against the gamepad id / Android InputDevice name. Combined mode uses the normal Xbox profile; only -L and -R use this profile.

orientation.upright: Half held as if attached to the phone: bumpers/triggers on top.
orientation.sideways: Half turned 90 degrees with the rail (inner edge) facing up, like a sideways Joy-Con. Left half: stick ends up on the left. Right half: buttons end up on the left.
orientation.note: Stick directions are reported in the sideways frame (e.g. pushing the left stick toward the bumpers reports D-pad Left).

controls.note: Confirmed in 4 labeling runs. The d-pad is NOT rotated like the stick: it reports as a face diamond mirrored left/right (left sends B, right sends X).
Confirmed in 4 labeling runs. See dpad_left.

controls.warning: Holding 3 s enters phone pairing; View + Bluetooth 5 s re-pairs the halves. Only bind to tap actions.

ignore.reason: Swipes, taps and clicks emit random bursts of d-pad buttons in no stable pattern. Not usable as a right stick or d-pad. Ignore these indexes on -R. Index 11 (touchpad click) is separate and usable.
